critique: The render has the correct orange/yellow fire color on black and changes between frames, but it reads as a small, soft circular fireball rather than an explosive directional muzzle flash. At 0.01 it is a dense blob; by 0.08 it has simply contracted and shifted slightly, with no clear forward flame cone, bright core, sparks, or expanding directional energy characteristic of the preset thumbnail.

suggestions.why: Increase main-particle life so the existing high forward velocity can form a visible forward flash/cone instead of a compact circular blob.
Reduce particle size so individual fast-moving particles resolve into an explosive flame shape rather than merging into one soft disk.
Keep the burst intense but shorten and reduce the emission spike, preventing the longer-lived particles from becoming an opaque uniform mass.
